synopsis: Chapter 2 and the glossary report that Honda investigation EA25-002 added 295,125 Insight and Passport vehicles in January 2025 [f1488, f15763]. Chapter 13 identifies it as a NHTSA engineering analysis investigating false automatic braking in that combined vehicle population [f10423]. The glossary describes the analysis as further Honda CMBS analysis; the supplied facts do not give a Passport-only vehicle count or an investigation outcome [f1488, f10423, f15763].

relations.note: Same analysis, January 2025 expansion, vehicle models, and combined count.
